<?php
$src = __DIR__ . '/storage/profil-fotos';
$dst = __DIR__ . '/storage/app/public/profil-fotos';
if (!is_dir($dst)) {
    mkdir($dst, 0775, true);
}
$results = [];
foreach (glob($src . '/*') ?: [] as $file) {
    if (!is_file($file)) {
        continue;
    }
    $name = basename($file);
    $to = $dst . '/' . $name;
    if (@rename($file, $to)) {
        $results[$name] = 'moved';
        continue;
    }
    if (@copy($file, $to)) {
        @unlink($file);
        $results[$name] = 'copied';
        continue;
    }
    $results[$name] = 'failed';
}
header('Content-Type: application/json');
echo json_encode([
    'status' => 1,
    'src' => $src,
    'dst' => $dst,
    'results' => $results,
    'src_remaining' => array_values(array_map('basename', glob($src . '/*') ?: [])),
    'dst_files' => array_values(array_map('basename', glob($dst . '/*') ?: [])),
], JSON_PRETTY_PRINT);
